potion.name: Healing tonic
potion.description: Restore {heal} HP to the selected living hero.

bomb.name: Ink bomb
bomb.description: Roll three reels for damage and poison against the selected enemy. Three alike can crit.

ward.name: Paper ward
ward.description: Add {block} shared block for this battle.

antidote.name: Antidote
antidote.description: Remove poison from the selected living hero.

bandage.name: Bandage
bandage.description: Restore {heal} HP to the selected living hero.

salve.name: Mending salve
salve.description: Restore {heal} HP to every living party member.

ember.name: Ember draught
ember.description: Stimulate the selected hero: a small damage and defence bonus for {stimulantTurns} of their actions.

oil.name: Sharpening oil
oil.description: Give the selected hero {rage} rage, adding damage until this battle ends.

frost.name: Frost vial
frost.description: Attempt a strength-{stun} stun on the selected enemy. Armour can absorb it.

firebomb.name: Cinder flask
firebomb.description: Deal {damageBase} plus floor depth divided by {depthDivisor}, rounded down, in magic damage to every enemy.

venom.name: Venom vial
venom.description: Poison the selected enemy for {poisonTurns} tiny, armour-piercing damage ticks.

chalk.name: Chalk map
chalk.description: Reveal adjacent and diagonal tiles without activating them. Cannot be used during combat.

ration.name: Trail ration
ration.description: Restore {healthPercent}% of the selected hero’s maximum HP.

ironSignet.name: Iron Signet
ironSignet.description: Tank equipment. Every damaging roll gains {attack} damage.

bulwarkBadge.name: Bulwark Badge
bulwarkBadge.description: Tank equipment. Start fights with {guard} team block; resist {defence} damage per incoming hit.

glassRosary.name: Glass Rosary
glassRosary.description: Healer equipment. Add {heal} HP to healing rolls.

mercyBell.name: Mercy Bell
mercyBell.description: Healer equipment. Every roll heals the party by {teamHeal} and adds {block} team block.

silentBoots.name: Silent Boots
silentBoots.description: Rogue equipment. +{attack} damage; every {stunEveryOrdinal} roll stuns the target.

serpentPin.name: Serpent Pin
serpentPin.description: Rogue equipment. Damaging rolls add a short poison.

starLens.name: Star Lens
starLens.description: Mage equipment. Add {magic} magic damage to every damaging roll.

stormQuill.name: Storm Quill
stormQuill.description: Mage equipment. Every {stimEveryOrdinal} roll grants a stimulant; +{magic} magic damage.
